_comment: Real Pixl program dates. Pixie computes relative time from these on every corpus refresh, so it says 'in 4 days' and 'already passed' instead of reciting a date that has silently gone stale. Leave milestones empty and the whole section is omitted — pixie will not guess a date it has not been given. Dates are ISO 8601; add a timezone if the exact hour matters.

milestones.name: Pixl official release
milestones.note: This is the official launch date. Any other date you may have seen for the launch is wrong.
